Source s0047 至常曾孫和 supports an inferred unnamed child of 田常 in the genealogy to 和 (Tian He). No invented name; descriptive kinship record only. Retain accepted membership; unresolvedIdentity false.

Later-clan passage s0045 pairs 田乞 with 田豹. Anchor shiji:037:p114 is the same 田乞 killing the Qi ruler at s0154, consistent with Tian lineage continuity. Shown candidate dossier headers are index-only; chapter Chinese does not assert a separate 田乞. Retain membership; preserve cross-chapter uncertainty.

Biography opens 司馬穰苴 and identifies Tian descent via 田穰苴 (s0001, s0004). Liangshu 009 p028 anchor cites 穰苴 in the same Sima Rangju military tradition (s0074). Lookup dossier per_ASHVKAAC3D0H41BDBX2S lists blocking zh:司馬穰苴 and zh:田穰苴 with shiji:064 claims. No contradictory actor in chapter text. Retain accepted cross-book cluster.

Campaign supervisor 莊賈 (s0007) is executed after lateness; abbreviated 賈 at s0009 matches the same officer. Local-only canonical anchor; no chapter evidence of a second Zhuang Jia. Retain accepted membership.

s0046 names 簡公 as the Qi ruler killed by 田常—the Qi Lord Jian of the closing genealogy, distinct from 景公 in the opening campaign. Title-only surface in this sentence; retain local ruler record with unresolvedIdentity true for cross-chapter title collisions only.

Same sentence also says 齊威王, but He’s personal name 和 is a separate local person from Wei Wang’s regnal title. Do not merge p016 with p010. Bounded overflow on 和 headers is not separation proof for this chapter’s He. s0045 lists 田豹 alongside 田乞 in the clan grievance narrative. Single-chapter officer; singleton canonical anchor. No evidence of a different Tian Bao. Retain membership.
